blocks.text: SEOUL — North Korea fired several missiles off its east coast Wednesday, Seoul’s military said, extending a burst of weapons testing as Pyongyang hardens its stance toward South Korea and the United States. The nuclear-equipped North has carried out a flurry of weapons tests in recent days, which come during heightened tensions between Pyongyang and Seoul over a landmine explosion along their heavily fortified border. South Korea’s Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) said its military “detected several missiles launched from the Sondok area of North Korea towards the East Sea on the morning of November 4”, referring to the body of water […]...
